name: Trouble Magia ~Wakeari Shoujo wa Mirai o Kachitoru Tame ni Ikoku no Mahou Gakkou e Ryuugaku Shimasu~
original_name: トラブル・マギア ～訳アリ少女は未来を勝ち取るために異国の魔法学校へ留学します～
source:
Girl meets boy in this adolescent tale of magic. Your year to seize the future is about to begin! 

The protagonist has a secret—she’s under a "curse" that abruptly transforms her into an animal. Although she aspires to become a magic knight, the curse makes it nearly impossible to find decent employment. Without breaking the curse, her future is at risk! In search of clues to lift the curse, she earns the qualification to study abroad and enrolls in the prestigious Revel Magic Academy in a magical kingdom in the western lands.

However, due to an unexpected incident, she ends up being monitored by the student council and must navigate school life while keeping her curse a secret. On top of that, she finds herself caught up in various troubles related to her curse and the events unfolding at the magic academy...

Set in a foreign magic academy, the story of a girl with a complicated past begins!
translation:
在这个青少年魔法故事中，女孩与男孩相遇。你把握未来的一年即将开始！

主角有一个秘密——她受到了“诅咒”，突然变成了动物。虽然她渴望成为一名魔法骑士，但诅咒使她几乎不可能找到体面的工作。如果不打破诅咒，她的未来就岌岌可危了！为了寻找解除诅咒的线索，她获得了出国留学的资格，进入了西部魔法王国久负盛名的狂欢魔法学院。

然而，由于意外事件，她最终受到学生会的监视，必须在学校生活中保持诅咒的秘密。除此之外，她还发现自己陷入了与诅咒和魔法学院发生的事件有关的各种麻烦之中……

以外国魔法学院为背景，一个有着复杂过去的女孩的故事开始了！
